headline: Small and short — clean early but not 3 hours' worth.
today: Knee-high S swell with light morning wind, so it'll be glassy and rideable but tiny, and the cross-on builds by afternoon. Fine if you're local, nowhere near drive-worthy. Save it.

daysToWatch.note: Size to 3.5ft but onshore and cross-on all day — junky and wasted. Skip it and wait one more day.
The standout — prime SE angle to 3.5ft with cross-off N dawn and light morning. Clean overhead-of-nothing size and the best window of the week. Worth the drive. Shortboard.
